jobs.detail: OUTSIDE LEG KICK PUSH-UP, THREE phases, whole body overhead-rear three-quarter camera enough to see TWO hips, two legs and all hands/feet. Head image LEFT, feet image RIGHT, mat wide under body. Hands wider than shoulders planted unchanged, fingers forward, core straight. LEFT bottom push-up: elbows bent about90degrees, torso straight low above mat, BOTH legs straight together behind, toes support. MIDDLE press elbows STRAIGHT to high plank and move RIGHT leg STRAIGHT OUT SIDEWAYS away from hip about45degrees (toward BACK/FAR side), right foot lifted clear, LEFT leg stays straight behind with left toes mat, pelvis level. RIGHT after next push-up repetition now high plank and LEFT leg straight out SIDEWAYS (toward FRONT/NEAR side), LEFT foot clear, RIGHT leg straight behind toes mat. Clearly exchange leg origins between two high plank phases, trace every hip-thigh-knee-shoe, no extra leg/no bent knee. Do not lift leg vertically behind; lateral abduction. Primary GLUTES red only SOFT DIFFUSE tint on intact opaque black side/rear hip shorts, no fiber/radial pattern/cutaway. All exposed limbs fine grayscale anatomical fibers, clothing fully opaque wraps whole seat/crotch/front/sides/rear. No red chest/triceps. No text.
